info.title: Uber Ads API
info.description: Complete reference for the Uber Ads external API. This document aggregates every endpoint (ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, product catalog, and reporting) into a single OpenAPI specification.

Target users who have an active Uber One membership subscription

Target users from a custom audience segment

CreateReports_ExternalSubmitReportJobReq.description: Request configuration for generating an asynchronous report

columns.description: List of dimensions and metrics to include in the report

time_unit.description:
Time unit for aggregation:
- DAILY: Day-by-day breakdown
- WEEKLY: Week-by-week aggregation (start date must be Monday)
- MONTHLY: Month-by-month aggregation (start date must be first of month)
- SUMMARY: Total aggregation across date range

Time Range Configuration:
- Weekly Reports: start_time must be Monday, end_time must be next Monday
- Monthly Reports: start_time must be first of month, end_time must be first of next month
- Daily/Summary Reports: any valid date range

Examples:
- Weekly: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z" to "2024-01-08T00:00:00Z"
- Monthly: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z" to "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z"
- Daily: "2024-01-15T00:00:00Z" to "2024-01-20T00:00:00Z"

filters.description: Filters to apply to the report
